name.en-US: On the Procession of the Holy Spirit
name.pt-BR: Sobre a processão do Espírito Santo

description.la: Anselmi de processione Spiritus Sancti contra Graecos, quam in concilio Barensi (1098) disputavit et postea composuit. Textus ex editione Migne (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853).
description.en-US: Anselm’s defence of the Latin doctrine that the Holy Spirit proceeds from the Father and the Son, against the Greeks, as argued before the Council of Bari (1098) and written down afterwards. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A defesa de Anselmo da doutrina latina de que o Espírito Santo procede do Pai e do Filho, contra os gregos, tal como a discutiu no Concílio de Bari (1098) e depois a redigiu.

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 158 (Paris 1853), the Gerberon text; TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text 10613, from the Open Greek and Latin machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with its chapter divisions and PL chapter summaries. PL page breaks, the column numbers and the apparatus of alternative chapter numbers (al.) are dropped; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
